# Reference-Encoder KTX2 Fixtures

Small 32x32 (and one 16x16) `.ktx2` textures and expected RGBA `.png` images generated by reference encoders to verify `tooling/ktx2`'s pure-Go BasisLZ/ETC1S, UASTC, BC7, and ASTC 4x4 decoders without requiring external binaries at test time.

## Generators and Licenses

- **Basis Universal (`basisu` v2.50.0, Apache-2.0)** — https://github.com/BinomialLLC/basis_universal
  - `etc1s_opaque_srgb.ktx2` + `.png`: `basisu -ktx2 -etc1s -mipmap -q 200` (opaque, sRGB, 6 mip levels)
  - `etc1s_alpha_srgb.ktx2` + `.png`, `_mip1.png`: `basisu -ktx2 -etc1s -mipmap -q 200` (alpha slice, sRGB, 6 mip levels)
  - `etc1s_opaque_linear.ktx2` + `.png`: `basisu -ktx2 -etc1s -mipmap -linear -q 200` (opaque, linear, 6 mip levels)
  - `etc1s_quad_linear.ktx2`: `basisu -ktx2 -etc1s -mipmap -linear -q 255` (16x16 four-quadrant solid color texture for `render3d.LoadKTX2` software-renderer tests)
  - `uastc_opaque_srgb.ktx2` + `.png`: `basisu -ktx2 -uastc -uastc_level 3 -mipmap -ktx2_no_zstandard` (uncompressed UASTC, opaque, sRGB)
  - `uastc_alpha_srgb.ktx2` + `.png`: `basisu -ktx2 -uastc -uastc_level 3 -mipmap -ktx2_no_zstandard` (uncompressed UASTC, alpha, sRGB)
  - `uastc_linear_zstd.ktx2` + `.png`, `_mip1.png`: `basisu -ktx2 -uastc -uastc_level 3 -mipmap -linear` (Zstandard-supercompressed UASTC, linear)
  - `bc7_alpha_srgb.ktx2` + `.png`, `bc7_opaque_linear.ktx2` + `.png`: raw BC7 blocks encoded with `basisu -dds -dds_format BC7 -dds_bc7e_scalar -dds_bc7e_scalar_level 6` (exercising multi-mode BC7), unpacked via `basisu -unpack`, and wrapped in a KTX2 v2.0 container.
- **Arm ASTC Encoder (`astcenc` v6.0.0, Apache-2.0)** — https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder
  - `astc4x4_opaque_linear.ktx2` + `.png`: `astcenc -cl ... 4x4 -thorough` decoded with `astcenc -dl` (void-extent, 1/2/3 partitions, dual-plane, BISE trits/quints) and wrapped in KTX2.
  - `astc4x4_alpha_srgb.ktx2` + `.png`: `astcenc -cs ... 4x4 -thorough` decoded with `astcenc -ds` (void-extent, multi-partition, dual-plane, alpha CEMs) and wrapped in KTX2.

All source inputs are synthetic procedurally generated patterns authored in this repository.
